Frequently Asked Questions

Are your intercity long-distance prices fixed?

Yes! All intercity fares are 100% fixed and confirmed on WhatsApp before your trip. There are no meter surcharges or fuel extras.

Can we stop for food and prayer during long highway drives?

Absolutely. Drivers accommodate rest stops at modern SASCO stations along the highway for prayer, coffee, and meals whenever you request.

Do you offer cross-border GCC long-distance transfers?

Yes, we provide cross-border private rides to Bahrain (via King Fahd Causeway), Qatar (Salwa Border), UAE, and Kuwait.

Which vehicle is best for long-distance travel with family?

We recommend our GMC Yukon XL Denali or Mercedes-Benz V-Class VIP for long intercity journeys for maximum legroom, reclining seats, and luggage space.
